text.en: 1. This order may be cited as the Dangerous Drugs Order 1969.        Citation.

2. Part III of the First Schedule to the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance yy, 336/56,
1952 is hereby amended by inserting in item 17 thereof immediately yy, 195/59.
after the words "Pethedine intermediate-C; and it salts (1-methyl-2 1. 165/61.
phenylpiperidine-4 carboxylic acid)" the following:                 L.N. 60/63.
"J.(3-cyano-3, 3-diphenylpropyl)-4-(2-oxo-3-propionyl-1 benzimida-
zolinyl)-piperidine (the proposed international non-proprietary name
of which is bezitramide)."

Made this 12th day of February, 1969.
[M. of H. 4542. AG. 250/54 SF. 106.]
DaTo' GANIE GILONG,
Minister of Health
